reference.title: Scenario 5 — Paragraph Between a Bullet list item
reference.shortdesc: Consider a bulleted list where the author has closed the <ul> element after a list

section.p:
Consider a bulleted list where the author has closed the
    element after a list item, inserted a

    element containing explanatory text, and then opened a new

      element to continue the list. Because the paragraph sits outside both list elements, it has no
    • markup, even though it appears visually between two bullets.

section.p: Result: The result depends on how the AI Agent interprets the split. If it infers continuation, the paragraph is nested inside the preceding <li> and the two <ul> elements are merged into a single DITA <ul>; otherwise, the paragraph and each <ul> are kept as separate, adjacent elements in the output.
